noPermission.title: Receiving returns is not your job here
noPermission.body: Your role does not receive customer returns at this site. Ask your team leader.

photo.parcelHint: Photograph the parcel and the products only: keep people out of the picture.
photo.lineHint: Photograph the garment only; mark the damage with an arrow or a circle.
photo.failed_one: {count} photo did not reach the office: the record stands; the office can add it.
photo.failed_other: {count} photos did not reach the office: the record stands; the office can add them.

offline.scan: No network: opening a return needs the office. Put the parcel aside until the network is back.
offline.receive: No network: you can count the garments; Receive waits for the network.

scan.label: Scan the return
scan.hint: The RMA sheet in the box, or the box label.
scan.where: Open the parcel at the dock: its RMA number opens the right return.

parcel.question: How did the parcel arrive?
parcel.ddtHint: Scan the number on the customer's delivery note, if there is one.
parcel.ddtKept: Delivery note {code} kept for the receipt.

held.condition: Say how the parcel arrived first
held.nothing: Count at least one garment first

allIn.title: Every garment arrived
allIn.grade: Nothing more is expected: grade what came.
allIn.body: Nothing more is expected on this return.

lines.scanHint: Its serial or batch label: it counts one on its line.
lines.title: What is expected
lines.partial: What does not arrive now stays expected on the return.

keys.count: Count one more on the row

noPermission.title: Grading is the inspector's
noPermission.body: Your role receives returns but does not grade them: put the goods at the inspection place.

grade.question: What condition is it in?
grade.officeDecides: The office decides what happens to it.
grade.pickFirst: Pick the tile that fits the garment.

restockHeld.safety: A protective garment returned for a defect goes back on the market only after a safety check: repair, quarantine or scrap.
restockHeld.usedPpe: A used protective garment is never restocked as new.
restockHeld.notNew: Only a new or like-new garment goes back to stock as new.

route.name: Place
route.inspection: It waits for the office's decision
route.noPlaceBody: This site has no inspection place: ask the warehouse lead where returns wait.
route.noLabel: No label prints from the tablet yet: keep the RMA sheet with the goods.

done.title: Return {number} received
done.body: {pieces} pieces received, {graded} garments graded on this tablet.
done.office: Customer service sees it now and decides the outcome.

NOT_OPEN.message: No open return with this code.
NOT_OPEN.fix: Put the parcel aside and tell customer service.

CHANGED.fix: It was read again: check the lines and send once more.

FULL.message: Every piece of this line is counted.
FULL.fix: A garment more than expected goes aside: tell customer service.

NO_LINE.message: This label is not on this return.
NO_LINE.fix: Check the garment's label, or put it aside and tell customer service.

PLACE.message: This is not the place for these goods.
PLACE.fix: Scan the label of the place shown.

BADGE.message: This badge does not open this tablet.
